instructions: Sales records owner_decision (APPROVE or CHANGE), owner_name, decision_date and, for CHANGE, resulting_specification_change and new_digest_and_review_required=true, through a reviewed pull request. Nothing here is decided until then.

items.title: Bathroom vanity wet-area material
items.current_wording: Room line "Branded plywood furniture · Laminate finish · …"; "Cabinet and furniture bodies in branded plywood"; "Hinged and sliding shutters in branded block board"
items.technical_specification: VANITY_UNIT.TOILET and VANITY_UNIT.DRESSER carry structure (approved-grade plywood, October baseline Sylvan Blu, 18 mm), doors (block board, Sylvan Primo Plus, 18 to 19 mm), surface, edges and hinges and channels; VANITY_UNIT.MIRROR is decorative
items.customer_impact: Customers with bathroom vanities are promised branded plywood and block board in a wet area
items.operational_impact: Every vanity must be built in those boards, or the promise is false
items.recommended_decision: APPROVE only if the same branded plywood and block board are used for bathroom vanities; otherwise CHANGE: move VANITY_UNIT.TOILET to the board category (Approved board structure)
items.if_changed: New specification version (ESSENTIAL-1.2) with VANITY_UNIT.TOILET moved from structure/doors to board; new digest and review

items.title: Utility wet-area material
items.current_wording: "Branded plywood utility unit · Laminate finish · Approved hinges and channels"
items.technical_specification: UTILITY.WALL carries structure, doors, surface, edges, handles and hinges and channels
items.customer_impact: Utility units are promised branded plywood and block board
items.recommended_decision: As S1: APPROVE only if confirmed; otherwise CHANGE: move UTILITY.WALL to the board category
items.if_changed: New version with UTILITY.WALL moved to board; new digest and review

items.title: Pooja-unit board and shutters
items.current_wording: "Approved board structure · Laminate finish · Approved hinges and channels"
items.technical_specification: POOJA_UNIT.UNIT carries board (no plywood promise) and surface; POOJA_UNIT.DOOR (standard doors) carries doors (block board), surface and hinges and channels; DOOR_CNC, BEADING and ASTA_CHAKRA are decorative
items.customer_impact: Standard pooja doors are promised as block board with laminate
items.operational_impact: Standard pooja doors must be block board with laminate
items.recommended_decision: APPROVE if standard pooja doors are block board with laminate
items.if_changed: New version moving POOJA_UNIT.DOOR out of doors; new digest and review

items.title: Shutter exceptions
items.current_wording: "Hinged and sliding shutters in branded block board"; any other board is named in the quotation
items.technical_specification: The doors category applies to the shutter lines of the kitchen, utility, wardrobe and loft, TV box and storage, crockery, study storage, vanities, storage boxes, standard pooja doors and window seats
items.customer_impact: Customers expect block-board shutters on every listed unit
items.operational_impact: Any non-block-board shutter (HDHMR, profile, glass) must be named in the quotation
items.recommended_decision: List the exceptions; CHANGE to remove them from the doors category, or APPROVE if there are none
items.if_changed: New version without the excepted lines in doors; new digest and review

items.title: TV-unit and wall-panelling material
items.current_wording: "Branded plywood TV unit · Laminate finish · Soft-close TV-unit hardware"; feature walls carry no material promise
items.technical_specification: TV_UNIT.PANEL carries structure and surface (laminate on plywood); FEATURE_WALL.* is decorative only
items.customer_impact: TV wall panels are promised as laminate on branded plywood
items.operational_impact: TV panels must be laminate on branded plywood
items.recommended_decision: APPROVE the TV panel; keep the feature wall as a final selection
items.if_changed: New version adjusting TV_UNIT.PANEL; new digest and review

items.title: Living-room soft-close TV-unit hardware
items.technical_specification: The card prices TV_UNIT.SOFT_CLOSE (TV box, every style) and TV_UNIT.SOFT_CLOSE_STORAGE (side storage for box-with-storage and panelled styles)
items.customer_impact: Every TV unit, panelled included, is promised soft-close hinges
items.operational_impact: Every TV box and storage shutter must have soft-close hinges
items.recommended_decision: APPROVE if every TV box and storage has soft-close hinges; otherwise CHANGE: drop the TV-unit lines from soft-close (and the owner decides the card)
items.if_changed: New version without TV_UNIT soft-close lines; new digest and review

items.title: Kitchen-accessory wording
items.current_wording: "Kitchen accessories you choose, such as wicker baskets, rolling shutters and pantry pull-outs, come from approved brands. They are planned within your Design Personalisation Allowance, not within the kitchen subtotal"
items.technical_specification: The card prices no accessory line; the accessories category is details-only wherever a kitchen is priced
items.customer_impact: Customers learn accessories are drawn from the allowance, not included in the kitchen
items.operational_impact: Accessories are quoted as their own lines and replace part of the allowance
items.if_changed: New version with revised accessory wording; new digest and review

items.title: Brand and approved-equivalent wording
items.current_wording: "Approved brands such as the named examples, or an approved equivalent of the same grade and specification. Final material and brand selections are confirmed in your detailed quotation."
items.technical_specification: Brand examples per category in ESSENTIAL-1.1 (Sylvan Blu; Sylvan Primo Plus; Merino, Century, Greenlam, Royal Touch, Stylam, Plain Art, Dazzle Berry, Airolam; Solid Edge, E3, URO, Red Star; Hettich; Blum; Nimmi; Ebco; Samsung Irex; Olive; Saint-Gobain; Philips; Wipro; Crompton; Avion; Asian Paints; Birla; Polycab; Finolex)
items.customer_impact: Named brands become expectations; equivalents need a clear rule
items.operational_impact: Every named brand must be currently procurable; equivalents need a recorded approval
items.recommended_decision: APPROVE after removing any brand not currently bought; equivalents approved by the designer and accepted by the customer in a quotation revision
items.if_changed: New version with the revised brand list; new digest and review

items.title: Package-picker wording
items.current_wording: "Branded materials and approved hardware, according to the selected rooms and product configuration."
items.technical_specification: Shown under Essential on the package screen (estimate-v2-copy.js promise.packageSubtitle)
items.customer_impact: No universal plywood or soft-close promise before rooms are priced
items.if_changed: Customer-copy change (no specification change); matrix and approval record updated; review

items.title: One-working-day designer callback
items.current_wording: "A designer will call you within one working day …" and the two confirmation messages
items.technical_specification: estimate-v2-copy.js promise.leadQuote, doneQuote and doneConsult; source ADR-012
items.customer_impact: Customers expect a call within one working day
items.operational_impact: Every V2 lead needs a call within one working day, with response-time monitoring
items.recommended_decision: APPROVE only with response-time monitoring in place; otherwise CHANGE to "A designer will call you to …" without a time commitment
items.if_changed: Customer-copy change; matrix and approval record updated; review
